units.source_text: 我大吃一惊，一直躁动不安的心，仿佛一下子冻结了似的。

en.t: I was deeply startled, and my heart, which had been restless all along, seemed to freeze all at once.

units.source_text: 于是我又一页页地往回翻起来，每页看一二句地倒着读了下去。

en.t: Then I began turning the pages back one by one, reading backward by glancing at one or two sentences on each page.

units.source_text: 我急于在最短的时间内弄清楚想要了解的事，

en.t: I was desperate to find out what I wanted to know in the shortest possible time,

units.source_text: 一眼望穿这满篇的文字，

en.t: trying to pierce through the whole page of writing with a single glance,

units.source_text: 那时，我最关心的只是先生的安危。

en.t: At that moment, the only thing I cared about was whether Sensei was safe.

units.source_text: 先生的过去，他曾答应过要告诉我的那个灰暗的过去，

en.t: Sensei's past, that gloomy past he had once promised to tell me about,

units.source_text: 对我来说已然毫无意义。

en.t: had already lost all meaning for me.

units.source_text: 我往回翻看了几页后，焦急地叠起了这封不肯轻易告诉我关键内容的长信。

en.t: After turning back through several pages, I anxiously folded up the long letter that would not easily tell me what I most needed to know.

units.source_text: 我又去病房门口，看了看父亲的情况。

en.t: I went again to the doorway of the sickroom to check on my father's condition.

units.source_text: 病人的枕边格外安静，面带倦容、忧心忡忡的母亲坐在那里。

en.t: The space by the patient's pillow was unusually quiet, and my mother sat there looking tired and worried.

units.source_text: 我向她招招手，问：“情况怎么样了？”

en.t: I beckoned to her and asked, "How is he doing?"

units.source_text: 母亲答道：“现在稳定些了。”

en.t: My mother answered, "He is a little more stable now."

units.source_text: 我走到父亲跟前，问道：“怎么样，灌肠后感觉好些了吗？”

en.t: I went up to my father and asked, "How do you feel? Did the enema make you feel any better?"

units.source_text: 父亲点点头，声音清晰地说了声“谢谢”。

en.t: My father nodded and said clearly, "Thank you."

units.source_text: 没想到父亲的神志还不糊涂。

en.t: To my surprise, my father's mind was still not clouded.
